name: TOPPLE
author: optim-agent
description:
Reverse-Polish 24-game. Clue is 'DDDD=T': four digits 1-9 and a target 10..99. A solution is
a POSTFIX (RPN) expression over + - * written with no spaces, e.g. '37*2-8+', that uses each
clue digit exactly once (as a multiset) and evaluates to T. The scorer is a 7-token stack
machine, which is why postfix and not infix -- eval() does not exist in the sandbox and an
infix parser does not fit in 256 chars. Targets are chosen among the *rarest* achievable
values, so brute force is needed. DIFFICULTY: hard.
DISCOVERY PATH: TOPPLE hints at a stack falling over (LIFO). The demo is the whole
game: teams see '3728=24' -> '37*2-8+' and an AI recognises postfix at once. Before the demo
teams will send infix and score 0. After it, the search is 24 perms x 5 tree shapes x 27 op
triples = 3240 candidates, milliseconds. Partial gradient: sending a *valid* RPN that uses the
right digits but misses T still scores 0, so the demo is what unlocks it -- this is the one I
expect only a couple of teams to crack, but it is fully mechanical once cracked.
